daily_load_assessment: Today's daily readiness is highly favorable. With a current CTL of 38.95 and an ATL of 35.55, your Training Stress Balance (TSB) stands at +3.4. Because there is no acute fatigue indicated by your current state, and today's Garmin recovery/sleep metrics are neutral/missing, you are cleared for high-intensity work. We will strike while the iron is hot and execute a quality interval session to drive adaptation.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the last 21-day training block, you accumulated 14.18 hours of volume across 15 sessions, resulting in 936 TSS. This represents a solid foundation, but the lack of recent structured intensity over the last few weeks means your CTL has plateaued in the high 30s. We need to reignite the progression. Your aerobic system is well-supported by your consistent historical commuting, meaning we can safely push the acute load upward to force a supercompensation effect.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Your long-term sport trend shows a strong, wide aerobic base but a clear gap between your current CTL of 38.95 and your milestone target of 60. To bridge this 21-point gap safely and effectively, we will enforce a strict, progressive ramp rate of +1.5 to +2.0 CTL per week. We will strictly adhere to the 70/30 pyramidal training distribution: 70% of your training will remain low-intensity base/strength to absorb the load, while 30% (2 to 3 sessions per week) will target high-intensity VO2max and threshold work.
coach_verdict: Based on a positive TSB of +3.4 and the need to break your current performance plateau, Priority 1 (VO2max Cycling Intervals) is your primary directive for today. This session directly targets your 5-minute peak power goals. If cycling is not preferred today, running intervals (Priority 2) serve as an excellent alternative to push your 5km pace threshold.

priority_1.workout_details: 15-minute progressive warm-up ending with 3 x 30-second primers at target wattage. Main set: 5 x 4-minute intervals at 290W (Zone 5, RPE 9/10), maintaining a cadence of 95-105 RPM. Recover with 4 minutes of easy spinning (under 130W) between intervals. 10-minute cool-down in Zone 1.
priority_1.reason: Directly addresses your primary goal of improving 5-minute peak power. Your fresh TSB (+3.4) ensures you have the neurological and muscular capacity to execute these high-intensity efforts with excellent quality.

priority_2.workout_details: 1.5 km easy jogging warm-up, followed by dynamic mobility drills and 3 x 80m strides. Main set: 5 x 1000m running at target 5km pace (RPE 8.5/10). Rest with 2 minutes of active walking/jogging recovery between reps. 1 km easy jog cool-down.
priority_2.reason: Directly targets running biomechanical efficiency and lactate clearance at 5km race pace. This fulfills one of your weekly high-intensity quality slots under the 70/30 rule.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 minutes of rowing or bodyweight squats. Barbell Back Squats: 3 sets of 5 reps at 80% 1RM (~90-100kg depending on baseline). Heavy Sandbag Carries: 3 sets of 40 meters. Kettlebell Swings (20kg): 3 sets of 15 reps focus on explosive hip extension. Hanging Knee Raises: 3 sets to failure.
priority_3.reason: Builds the structural durability and high-torque capabilities needed to sustain high-wattage cycling and powerful running strides, while giving the cardiovascular system a break.
